**Perf session (every bulk run, added 2026-10-28; [../perf.md](../perf.md) 14).** Every `scratch_server.sh` server now
records JFR (`CE_PERF=0` at setup turns it off). Before the first boot run `bash tools/perf/session/perf_session.sh start`;
before each entry run `perf_session.sh mark <ID>` (scratch_server.sh logs boot / cmd / stop itself); after the last
server has stopped run `perf_session.sh stop`, then `perf_session.sh report` (no server up while it parses; no `--prune`, the raw recordings are kept for debugging since 2026-10-31).
`perf/sessions/<name>/summary.md` gives each boot's launch-to-Done time and each entry's tick median / p95 / ticks over
50 ms / CPU / chunk waits, plus the worst ticks with the commands before them. Add a line to the Run log naming the
session. Disk: `/` is nearly full; one boot's recording is capped at `JFR_MAX` (1g) and `--prune` deletes every raw file, so do not use it; when space runs out, delete by hand the recordings of boots whose rows all passed.
Benchmarks (boot, idle, pregen, reload) are the perf suite's G scenarios ([../perf_suite.md](../perf_suite.md), its own
runner), not queue rows.

Setup notes (from the 2026-10-22 run):

- A config key added in the current jar may be missing from the instance's toml (Forge adds it with its default at
  load). `grep` the key in `OUT/srv/config/` before relying on a `sed`; add the line under its section if it's absent.
- Server configs that ship through `defaultconfigs/` are merged from `configs_edited/server_config/` by
  `tools/build_deploy.py`. To test what a new player world gets, copy `configs_edited/server_config/*.toml` into
  `OUT/srv/defaultconfigs/` before the first boot of a new level.
- After a restart, wait about 30 s after `forceload add` before scheduling block ticks there; 5 s was too short.
- Probes: never call `getType()` on every recipe, use `Ingredient.getStacks()` (not `getItems()`), compare boxed
  config Booleans as text. Details in memory `rhino-fieldandmethods-gotcha`.
- `/dumpall` on a scratch server: recipes, tags, loot, structures, biomes, spawns and trades are good to copy into
  the instance's `kubejs/exported/`. Names, stacks, mob effects, gear, food, crops, compost, paintings and items by
  mod need the client (no mod lang files or client-only mods on a dedicated server).

Setup notes (from the 2026-10-22 second run; Rhino names in memory `rhino-fieldandmethods-gotcha`):

- No player on a dedicated server: Moonlight's soft-fluid item map stays empty until a player joins or `/reload`
  (`/fdtest soupjar` fills it itself now). Villager trades are built at server start: trade script changes need a
  restart. Probe blocks reuse fixed spots: clear them first in a world that ran a probe before.
- KubeJS hides or renames some vanilla methods: `DamageSource.getEntity()` is `getActual()`, `hurt()` is reached
  through `attack()`, `ItemStack.setTag` / `hasTag` / `Entity.getUUID` are hidden (use `Item.of(id, n, nbt)`, `.nbt`,
  `getGameProfile().getId()`), `ItemStack.enchant()` returns a copy, `level.dimension` is a property. A recipe
  wrapper's `getType()` is the serializer id (`minecraft:crafting_shaped`).
- Uncaught Java errors (no JS `catch`): reading `VillagerTrades` (roll real villagers instead), a `const` inside a
  nested block that runs twice (use `let`). `ConfigTracker` is blocked by KubeJS's class filter (read the mod's own
  config statics).
- Zombies are undead: no Regeneration or Poison on them (use a pillager).
- `/vtdtest` builds at y = -60; since 2026-10-27 its crop survival checks sit at the build limit, so `crops` passes in a normal world too. Adding a placed feature to another biome
  in the same step (scratch biome modifier) crashes spawn generation with a feature order cycle.

### Round 2: with a client window

One JVM at a time (memory `one-game-instance-at-a-time`): this round is run with the scratch server stopped. Either a
throwaway client on a single-player world (`tools/item_repro/launch_client.py GAME_DIR`, memory `client-launch-for-defaults`;
fresh `config/`, so client defaults are the pack's) or the user's own game. A single-player world has the integrated
server, so server probes (`/vtdtest`, `/fdtest`) also run there. Rows say what to look at; the full steps are in the
named writeup test. Cheapest order: CQ-DUMP first (everything after the Vintage rows depends on it), then one creative
superflat world for the visual groups, then a normal world for the world-feel groups.

Planned (not built): [../client_capture.md](../client_capture.md) runs the capturable rows unattended and leaves one
cropped PNG per test ID in `test_captures/`; once it exists these rows get a `Capture` column (spec / manual / partial).

Fixes made in the run (pack and jar):

1. `R.replaceInput` / `R.replaceOutput` (NCH) take `includeAdded`: KubeJS 1902.6 swaps only recipes loaded from data,
   never script-added ones. Item merges pass it (`[itemMerges] 2 swaps in script-added recipes`: the two Canned Coffee
   Berries recipes). Opt-in because a swap replaces the whole matching slot (sugar -> `#forge:sugar` turned a
   `[sugar, honey]` slot into the tag alone when it ran on added recipes).
2. `item_merges.js`: Respite's kettle has no KubeJS schema, so gambler's tea is removed and rebuilt with `R.frBrewing`
   on Rustic's beans. `mortar.js` skips catalog entries naming a purged item (`[mortar] 6 of 7`).
3. `tool_effects.js` and `sample_syringe.js`: `event.getSource().getEntity()` threw (KubeJS name `getActual()`), so no
   on-hit tool effect and no syringe hit sample ever happened.
4. `trades.js`: MoreJS 0.3.0 reads `[1, 5]` as level 1 only (both ends from the first entry); every level range is a
   real `IntRange(1, 5)` now, so the cleric, chef and engineer removals and the Canned Food filter reach levels 2 to 5.
5. patcherMod `StemExtraFruit`: grows only the stem's own fruit (Delightful's slices and cantaloupe extend the vanilla
   blocks and report the vanilla stem; re-pointing only knew the real fruit).
6. patcherMod `OceanGeodes.untouched` checks the alternate inner layer too (Geode Plus' prismarine geode keeps its
   budding prismarine there; the inner layer is plain prismarine).
7. `jeed_providers.js` skips Xaero's map effects when the mod is not loaded (12 `[NCH] jeedProvider failed` errors on
   every dedicated server boot).
8. `tools/build_deploy.py`: runtime rules for `mortar_catalog.json` and `placed_food_slices.json` (the release
   preflight refused to build without them). New `tools/changelog_test/scratch_deploy_build.py` runs the release
   build into a scratch folder (SQ-OM-17).

Targets patcherMod 1.1.07 **build/libs 2026-11-02 00:42** (not in `mods/` yet; prep_srv.sh swaps it in) with `waterReach` (new,
default 2) and the `earth_fill/sand_base` tags, and the instance `[worldgen.earth_fill]`:
`baseLayers` 3, `beardReach` 6 (air), `waterReach` 2 (water), `buryReach` 10, `maxMoundHeight` 8, `maxOverWater` 24, sizes small 24/8, medium 64/24,
large 160/64, huge 320/128 (bounds 150/600/2000), `maxWaterSurplus` **0.5** (the instance value since 2026-11-02, was 0.0;
the 7.5 writeup default; the code default is 0), `footprintMinWater` 9, `pruneMinWetColumns` 16, `beardFootprint` false, override `eugene:undead_castle=24,800,400`.
Earth fill only cancels or prunes; the blocks are replaced by the vanilla beard (water and air under a bearded piece, out
to `beardReach`; since 2026-11-02 earth over water deeper than `waterReach` 2 already counts toward `maxOverWater`, so deep fill is
judged even where the beard could reach it) and by ground match (template earth swapped for the native ground). The earlier SQ-EF rows checked the
log lines; these check that the world matches them. Probe: `/zq under <x> <z> <rChunks> [id text|-]` in
`tools/scratch_query/zq_probe.js` (prep_srv.sh copies it in), **new 2026-11-02 and untested**: SQ-EFB-01 debugs it first.

(`chunky center <x> <z>`, `chunky radius 300`, `chunky start`) and wait for it to finish before probing; a square is
probed in tiles of `rChunks` 6 (the probe prints at most 30 starts per call). Every probe line is kept in
`RES/rows/<ID>.log` for the comparison rows (11 to 13).

block texture fix (both built 2026-11-06 late, see TODO `creativebrewing/publish #3`, `creativedelight/framework #14`),
the other jars as installed in the pack 2026-11-06 01:30; copy all five into `CEPortTesting/mods/`. Supersedes SQ-CBS-01 and CQ-CBS-01. Everything runs
from the CEPortTesting instance: `bash tools/scratch_query/port_chain.sh check` first (prints `MISSING` / `STALE` lines:
copy the pack's jar over, game closed). Server rows use `port_chain.sh server OUT LEVEL A|B chain|instance` (a scratch
dedicated server built from CEPortTesting's jars, empty `config/`, CEPortTesting's `kubejs/` plus the /zq probe), then
`scratch_server.sh boot|stop OUT` and `qrun.py run` as usual. **chain** = the 14 jars Creative Brewing needs, all the way
down: Rhino, Architectury, KubeJS, Create, KubeJS Create, KubeJS Delight, LootJS, MoreJS, Serene Seasons, Common, Compat,
Calendar, Delight, Brewing (+ the `*_upstream` donor folders). **instance** = every non-client jar CEPortTesting has (adds
Quark, Supplementaries, Fruits Delight, Hostile Delight, More Delight, Worldgen, ...). Boots, one JVM at a time:
(1) chain, group A, fresh: CBA-01 to -10; (2) same OUT, `[members] vinery = false`: CBA-11; (3) same OUT, vinery back on,
`brewinandchewin = false`: CBA-12; (4) new OUT, `NOUPSTREAM=vinery_upstream`: CBA-13; (5) new OUT,
`DROP="kubejsdelight-*.jar SereneSeasons-*.jar morejs-forge-*.jar"`: CBA-14; (6) new OUT, instance, group B: CBA-15 to -18. Client rows run
in CEPortTesting itself through ATLauncher: `port_chain.sh bare` parks every non-chain jar in
`disabledmods/cba_parked/` (game closed), `port_chain.sh restore` puts them back; a new creative superflat world each.
Superflat surface: blocks at y -61, air from -60; spawn chunks around 0 0 stay loaded.

## SQ-CBO Creative Brewing with and without its optional dependencies, 2026-11-06 ([creative_brewing.md](../creative_brewing.md) 2.4, 2.5 and 6, [plan_cb_publish.md](../plan_cb_publish.md) M2, TODO `creativebrewing/publish #10`)

Not run. Every Creative Brewing (CB) behaviour, booted three ways: (1) the bare **chain** (only CB's hard dependencies:
nothing optional), (2) **optional** = the chain plus all 24 optional dependencies in CB's `mods.toml` and their own
required jars, (3) the chain plus **one** optional mod at a time (proves each guard alone: a guard that checks one mod
but names another fails only here). Needs the 2026-11-06 13:23 builds of Creative Brewing and Creative Common and the 13:17 Creative
Delight (`development/*/build/libs/`) copied into `CEPortTesting/mods/` with the game closed, then `port_chain.sh check`
clean. CEPortTesting has 10 of the 24 optional mods; `port_chain.sh` takes the rest from the pack's `mods/` (read only).
Tools (2026-11-06): `port_chain.sh server OUT LEVEL A optional`, `ADD="glob,glob"` (comma-separated, jar names
with spaces work) on a `chain` server, `port_chain.sh bare optional` for the client; probe `tools/scratch_query/cbo_probe.js`
(copied into every port_chain server as `zz_cbo_probe.js`: `/cbo mods|effects|potions|all`). All server rows are group
A (superflat, blocks at y -61). **Effect check pattern** (rows say "golem check"): `> forceload add 0 0`; `> summon
minecraft:iron_golem 0 -60 5 {Tags:["cbo"],NoAI:1b}`; `> effect give @e[tag=cbo] <from> 60 0`; `> data get entity
@e[tag=cbo,limit=1] ActiveEffects` (Forge writes the effect id as `"forge:id": "<id>"`); `> kill @e[tag=cbo]`.
**Base checks S** (every boot below): `bootexpect \[creativebrewing\] members: \[vinery, brewinandchewin\]$`;
`bootreject Missing or unsupported mandatory\|Mixin apply failed\|InvalidMixinException\|creativebrewing.*(NoClassDefFoundError\|ClassNotFoundException)\|Encountered an unexpected exception`;
`shell ! grep -nE "ReferenceError|TypeError|EvaluatorException|is not defined" logs/kubejs/startup.log logs/kubejs/server.log`;
`> cbo all`: `expect effects leaks 0` (a `leak` line names an Armor or Tool Effects row whose item or effect is not
registered: a missing `global.has` guard). Boots, one JVM at a time: chain 1, optional 1 (+1 restart for -18), single
24, pairs 4: about 30 boots of 2 to 3 min each, about 1.5 h. Client rows after the server rows.

## SQ-CGE Creative Common 1.1.0 of 2026-11-08 00:01: low gravity for falling blocks, items and TNT, and the re-check list for the publish ([creative_engineering.md](../creative_engineering.md) 7.1, TODO `creativecommon/publish #3`)

Not run. Targets `development/creativeCommon/build/libs/creativecommon-1.1.0.jar` of 11-08 00:01 (newer than the 11-07 20:28 jar in `mods/`; prep_srv.sh and `cc_only_srv.sh` swap it in, install it in `mods/` only with the game closed). New code: `CreateGravityEntitiesMixin` (gated on `create_gravity`; `require = 0`, so a wrong method name skips silently: SQ-CGE-02 is the real check). Servers: full pack for SQ-CGE-01 to -05, `bash tools/scratch_query/cc_only_srv.sh OUT LEVEL full` for SQ-CGE-06. Probe scripts go in `tools/scratch_query/` (`cge_probe.js` or `.qb` batch `batches/r1108cge/`).
Entity speed rows: `/forceload add 0 0`, summon at y 120 over the End main island (0, 120, 0) and over a flat overworld spot, read `Pos[1]` after 20 and 40 ticks with `data get entity @e[type=...,limit=1] Pos[1] 1000`; vanilla pull is -0.04 per tick, so 40 ticks drop about 27 blocks, and Create Gravity's default End factor -0.8 should leave about a fifth of that.

## SQ-CGE part 2: low gravity for every falling entity without motion packets, dimension limit, End oxygen, script phase, physics tags, 2026-11-08 ([creative_engineering.md](../creative_engineering.md) 7.4, TODO `creativecommon/publish #3`)

Targets Common `creativecommon-1.1.0` and Compat `creativecompat-1.0.0` of 11-08 15:08 (build/libs, NOT installed; install the two together: the new Common moves only files headed `// phase: helpers` ahead of `startup_scripts/`, and only the new Compat has that header on `jei_order.js`). New mixins `LowGravityPullMixin` (items, falling blocks, TNT, minecarts, Shulker bullets), `LowGravitySlowPullMixin` (XP orbs, fishing bobbers), `LowGravityArrowMixin`, `LowGravityLlamaSpitMixin`, `LowGravityBoatMixin` (out of water only), `LowGravityThrowableMixin`, `LowGravityItemPhysicMixin` (items under ItemPhysic), accessor `CreateGravityConfigAccessor`; all `require = 1`, so a wrong target crashes the boot (SQ-CGE-07 is the first row of the first boot).

**How to run** (all scripted, one game JVM at a time; targeted run, no perf session):
- Server, five boots in one go (b5 = SQ-CGE-16, ItemPhysic without Create Gravity): `bash tools/scratch_query/cge2_run.sh server OUT` (OUT under the session scratchpad). b1 full pack group A superflat (level r1108cge2, configs as generated) -> b2 same world with Create Gravity `biome_configs = ["#minecraft:is_end;;-1", "#minecraft:is_nether;;"]` -> b3 same world with Common `gravityDimensions = ["minecraft:the_end", "minecraft:the_nether"]` -> b4 `cc_only_srv.sh full` (Common without Compat). The runner copies Common and Compat from build/libs into each srv (refuses if they are not these builds), edits the configs while stopped (Forge writes its copy back on shutdown), stops on a boot crash. Results `perf/runs/r1108cge2/b1..b4/`.
- Client, single player: `cge2_run.sh client OUT GAME` (throwaway client, the two jars copied into its mods/, the b1 world as CGE2), then `eval_client.py launch GAME`, open CGE2, `qrun.py client GAME tools/scratch_query/batches/r1108cge2/c1_sp.qb perf/runs/r1108cge2/c1`.
- Client joined to a dedicated server (needs a client and a server up together, which the one-game-JVM rule does not allow an agent to start; owner's call; the only path that uses the synced config on the client): `cge2_run.sh join OUT` (b1 srv with default configs, left up), in the client Multiplayer > Direct Connection > `localhost:25599`, `cge2_run.sh op OUT`, then `qrun.py client GAME .../c2_join.qb perf/runs/r1108cge2/c2`; `cge2_run.sh stop OUT` after.
- Fall rows are judged by `tools/scratch_query/cge_judge.py` (per type: End drop / overworld drop at 40 ticks; `low` 0.10-0.30, `zero` under 0.01 blocks, `same` within 2 percent); probe `cge_probe.js` `/zgv dropall` drops a falling block, item, TNT, XP orb, arrow, snowball, boat, minecart and llama spit.
